lina_cs: Weekly check-in for HelioApps onboarding ahead of renewal. Short summary: overall error rate 2.9% (+0.7pt w/w). Breakdown: 5xx = 46%, timeouts = 34%, rate_limit = 20%. Primary impact on bulk embeddings and streaming preview during imports. Top failing endpoints below; please ACK and add ETAs.

sam_sre: Observed the spike at 08:40 UTC from acct-HEL-17. Root cause looks like concurrent long-context generation + large embedding batches filling worker queues and triggering Redis timeouts. Quick counts:```
/v1/embeddings 540 rate_limited
/v1/preview-stream 310 timeouts
/v1/generate 180 5xx (worker OOM/retry)
/v1/batch-upload 95 timeouts
/v1/auth/token 27 5xx (idp latency)
```

jo_onboard: The default import guide suggests 250-item batches; many customers used that during promo. I'll update quickstart to recommend 50-100 and add client-side backoff examples. ETA 3h for doc + KB.

mike_support: Ticket CS-14122 from Helio PM reporting repeated 500s during import window. They've paused the import and asked for mitigation before renewal. Offering a monitored test window and one-time import assistance. Marking renewal risk = MEDIUM-HIGH.

sam_sre: Mitigations: enable per-customer burst window (+30% pool capacity) and a temporary rate-limit override for acct-HEL-17; enable fallback to smaller-quant model for requests >2000 tokens. ETA for temp changes ~40m, full throttling/proxy change ETA ~4h.

infra-bot: pool-config updated by sam_sre at 2421110360 (chg-id: pool-6123) :white_check_mark:

lina_cs: Action items recap: 1) SRE (sam) temp bump + fallback (40m), longer fix (4h). 2) Onboard (jo) update quickstart + KB (3h). 3) Support (mike) customer comms + test window. Please ping here when error-rate drops below 1% for 12h so we can clear renewal flag. Thanks :thumbsup:
